rounds.verseText: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,
rounds.teachingNote: Review Deuteronomy 34:10 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And ye shall compass the city, all ye men of war, and go round about the city once. Thus shalt thou do six days.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Joshua 6:3 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the separate cities for the children of Ephraim were among the inheritance of the children of Manasseh, all the cities with their villages.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Joshua 16:9 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the border compasseth it on the north side to Hannathon: and the outgoings thereof are in the valley of Jiphthahel:
rounds.teachingNote: Review Joshua 19:14 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the people answered and said, God forbid that we should forsake the Lord, to serve other gods;
rounds.teachingNote: Review Joshua 24:16 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 1:23 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 3:5 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Praise ye the Lord for the avenging of Israel, when the people willingly offered themselves.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 5:2 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Then said all the trees unto the bramble, Come thou, and reign over us.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 9:14 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Howbeit the king of the children of Ammon hearkened not unto the words of Jephthah which he sent him.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 11:28 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the Spirit of the Lord began to move him at times in the camp of Dan between Zorah and Eshtaol.
rounds.teachingNote: Review Judges 13:25 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Then Eli answered and said, Go in peace: and the God of Israel grant thee thy petition that thou hast asked of him.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 1:17 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: When the Philistines took the ark of God, they brought it into the house of Dagon, and set it by Dagon.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 5:2 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Now therefore hearken unto their voice: howbeit yet protest solemnly unto them, and shew them the manner of the king that shall reign over them.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 8:9 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Saul's uncle said, Tell me, I pray thee, what Samuel said unto you.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 10:15 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Only fear the Lord, and serve him in truth with all your heart: for consider how great things he hath done for you.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 12:24 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: So the Lord saved Israel that day: and the battle passed over unto Bethaven.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 14:23 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Saul sent to Jesse, saying, Let David, I pray thee, stand before me; for he hath found favour in my sight.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 16:22 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the Philistine said unto David, Am I a dog, that thou comest to me with staves? And the Philistine cursed David by his gods.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 17:43 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Then they told David, saying, Behold, the Philistines fight against Keilah, and they rob the threshingfloors.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 23:1 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Now the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek: and the Israelites pitched by a fountain which is in Jezreel.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Samuel 29:1 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Phaltiel the son of Laish.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 3:15 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And these be the names of those that were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shammuah, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon,
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 5:14 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 7:16 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Mephibosheth had a young son, whose name was Micha. And all that dwelt in the house of Ziba were servants unto Mephibosheth.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 9:12 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Unto whom David said, If thou passest on with me, then thou shalt be a burden unto me:
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 15:33 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the king said unto him, Why speakest thou any more of thy matters? I have said, Thou and Ziba divide the land.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 19:29 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimeah the brother of David slew him.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 21:21 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: For who is God, save the Lord? and who is a rock, save our God?
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 22:32 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: He was more honourable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Samuel 23:23 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Now the days of David drew nigh that he should die; and he charged Solomon his son, saying,
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 2:1 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Barley also and straw for the horses and dromedaries brought they unto the place where the officers were, every man according to his charge.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 4:28 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And there were four undersetters to the four corners of one base: and the undersetters were of the very base itself.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 7:34 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: (For six months did Joab remain there with all Israel, until he had cut off every male in Edom:)
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 11:16 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: But as for the children of Israel which dwelt in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 12:17 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Ahab the son of Omri did evil in the sight of the Lord above all that were before him.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 16:30 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: So Obadiah went to meet Ahab, and told him: and Ahab went to meet Elijah.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 18:16 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: So Ahab slept with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his stead.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Kings 22:40 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Now Jehoram the son of Ahab began to reign over Israel in Samaria the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, and reigned twelve years.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 3:1 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut the door upon him, and went out.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 4:21 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Yet Edom revolted from under the hand of Judah unto this day. Then Libnah revolted at the same time.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 8:22 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: But they gave that to the workmen, and repaired therewith the house of the Lord.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 12:14 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And Amaziah the son of Joash king of Judah lived after the death of Jehoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 14:17 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 17:18 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 19:33 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the servants of Amon conspired against him, and slew the king in his own house.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 21:23 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And also for the innocent blood that he shed: for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood; which the Lord would not pardon.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 2 Kings 24:4 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 1:6 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 2:31 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 3:12 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 4:24 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 5:15 and the full verse before continuing.

rounds.verseText: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
rounds.teachingNote: Review 1 Chronicles 6:27 and the full verse before continuing.
